title: Father's final year and illness
summary: Father played until a year before he died, a year after Arthur's mother's death when Arthur was 12.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Did he play right up until the time of his death or had he been sick long?

Well, he played up until a year before he died. He stood sick in bed a year and died one year before he died. Because my mother died when I was 12. And then right after she died, he took sick and he died a year later, a year after her.
